plan_owner_impacts.evidence: Conductor proves a keyboard-first multi-pane Settings composition: a persistent numbered command index, left-to-right drill panes (index / category / rows-or-manager), a persistent breadcrumb path bar, a key-hint status strip, and an exact setting editor that opens beneath its context row instead of a modal. The spec should adopt the explicit pane-count state machine (3/2/1 panes by width) as a recognized narrow model.

All 828 rows render from PM2_INVENTORY via store.rowsFor/resolveRow; the concept adds no rows and hides none. Legacy scope metadata is surfaced only inside the editor's Details drawer as impact-analysis prose, never as a scope control.

Keyboard grammar demonstrated end to end: ArrowUp/Down move within a pane, Enter/ArrowRight drill, ArrowLeft/Backspace retreat one Settings level, Ctrl/Cmd+K focuses search, Escape runs the popup-to-Home ladder. Candidate command ids are registered in candidate-command-delta.json; none are minted as canon.

Permissions & FileSafe renders through the shared m.permissions view model (sections projected into the Conductor Q/A grid and compact tables); managed rows carry origin in the row-state note and the Details drawer.

Installation rosters show selected/shadowed/manual-only flags with their honest notes, ask-first updates run through the install-update trigger, verification-failed history renders in the provider Activity log, and the Cursor CLI setup tab shows official source + exact host choice with sign-in as a separate step. All provider state strings come from PMProvider resolvers.
Provider account rosters render enabled/priority/sticky/use-next metadata inside the roster detail drawer; sign-in ownership comes from resolveAuthBoundary and is shown as the accounts-section note.
m.hosting renders as a reserved owner shell with the honest hosted-on card; no storage actions are fabricated.

The copy transaction is presented as four advancing panels (source / categories / preview / confirm+receipt) with a typed COPY confirm, truthful staged op phases (restore point, determinate apply, verify), and a receipt whose rollback genuinely restores via PM2.copy.rollback. One-time language is explicit in the intro and the receipt; no sync affordance exists.

Model tables render the shared columns (context, modes, tools, route) with requested-vs-effective routing surfaced in the Routing & fallback section; capability words are never derived from model names in this concept.

settings_inventory_impacts.note: legacyScope arrays are rendered only as a human sentence in the editor Details drawer ('Before the project-only model this lived at ... scope'). Candidate impact: the inventory should eventually drop or re-key this metadata once the project-only migration is canonized.

69 action-typed rows render as Run buttons returning honest simulated receipts. Several duplicate manager actions (for example doctor checks); a future inventory pass could cross-link them to their owning manager id so concepts can route instead of simulating.

64 list/keyvalue rows show their current entries read-only in the editor with an honest note that the collection is managed in its owning surface. The inventory could carry an owningManager hint to make that jump explicit.

note: Everything above is a concept-register observation. Canon is never minted here; the implementation audit adjudicates.
